title: The pockets, full
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Thursday. The pockets, emptied onto the shop's counter: the misfold, the November note, the July note, the pulled strip, a walrus napkin's corner, seven postcards' worth of a rubber band, a mat offcut, dimes. The owner looks. Says put it back. He does. The coat's heavier than the man.

panels.composition: The shop's counter. WOOD emptying the chore coat's pockets onto it. The OWNER watching.

image.prompt: a young man emptying the pockets of a canvas chore coat onto a shop counter while a woman in reading glasses watches, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The counter: a misfolded booklet, two notes, a folded strip, a torn napkin corner, a rubber band, an offcut, dimes.

image.prompt: close on a shop counter covered in small objects: a misfolded booklet, two notes, a folded comic strip, a torn napkin corner, a rubber band, a piece of mat board and dimes, black and white, no words
image.notes: The pocket's contents, Dec 2000. The misfold (objects.md: kept through 2027).

image.prompt: a woman in reading glasses looking at objects on a counter, dry, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The pockets refilled. The coat heavier. Wood in it. The coat's heavier than the man and the strip draws it that way: the coat solid, the man in eight strokes.

image.prompt: a young man in a canvas chore coat with bulging pockets, the coat drawn solid and the man in eight sparse strokes, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: The pockets emptied and refilled. The coat heavier than the man. Eight strokes.
